posts.summary:
“Matic” was one of the first ten words my son learned.. and he treats it as the fifth member of the family.
Using
@maticrobots
 also made it clear to me that useful home robots are here to stay.
They continue to surprise and delight us with gestures like this - true 10 year
Introducing Cues:  Voice & Gesture control for Matic
We raised $115M and spent 9 years to make the world’s first intuitive home robot
Say you spilled coffee: Point to the spill and say, "Hey Matic, clean this" and it will hear, see, locate in 3D, and go clean on its own.
Matic
